dct_description_sm: GINA supports the following University of Alaska projects. (1) Statewide Digital Mapping Initiative is a cooperative state program endorsed by the Governor and implemented by the Department of Natural Resources (DNR), Department of Military and Veterans Affairs (DMVA) and the University of Alaska (UA). GINA hosts the SDMI data services and provides access to the SDMI data archive. (2) The NSSI Catalog portal provides GIS data services and project tracking in support of the North Slope Science Initiative as a public service to Alaska, the Nation, and the Circumarctic region . (3) The UAS Spatial Data project is supporting datasets associated with cruise ship discharge, watershed delineation, glacial hydrology, and water-resources in Southeast Alaska. (4) The Alaska Volcano Observatory is provided realtime data for monitoring volcanic events. GINA holds a large inventory of satellite images and aerial photos, mostly over the State of Alaska. The majority of data is available online and can be freely downloaded. Data held or indexed by GINA can be accessed via several paths: i) Alaskan MODIS Images, ii) SwathViewer, iii) Alaska Mapped,  iii) Landsat data for Alaska; and iv) Satellite Data Search. GINA also offers real-time reception, processing, and delivery of imagery and information products from a variety of polar-orbiting satellites.
